title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full Stack Developer

Company: Vxplore Technologies

Location: Bally, Howrah

Experience: Minimum 1 Year

Salary: As per experience, technical knowledge and interview performance

Job Type: Full\-Time

About the Role

Vxplore Technologies is looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer with hands\-on experience in both front\-end and back\-end development. The candidate should be capable of working on new and existing web applications.

Must\-Have Technical Skills

\- React.js

\- Node.js

\- Next.js

\- CodeIgniter 4

\- JavaScript / ES6\+

\- HTML5 \& CSS3

\- PHP

\- MySQL / SQL

\- REST API development and integration

\- Git / GitHub

\- Responsive web development

Key Responsibilities

\- Develop and maintain full\-stack web applications.

\- Build and integrate APIs and database solutions.

\- Work on both new and existing projects.

\- Debug, troubleshoot and optimize applications.

\- Write clean, scalable and maintainable code.

\- Collaborate with the development team to deliver projects efficiently.

Good to Have

Knowledge of TypeScript, Express.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS/Bootstrap, AWS, Docker or CI/CD will be an added advantage.

Candidate Requirements

\- Minimum 1 year of relevant experience.

\- Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.

\- Good understanding of full\-stack development.

\- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

\- Good communication skills and willingness to learn.

Interested candidates are invited to apply and grow with Vxplore Technologies.

Or apply on Indeed directly
